name: gitlab-status-policy
description: Publish GitLab commit status for the resolved commit after push.

post-push.description: Publish a commit status to GitLab for the resolved commit.

steps.run: PROJECT_ID=${CI_PROJECT_ID:-$(glab repo view --json id -q .id)}; if [ "{{options.dry-run}}" = "true" ]; then echo DRY RUN: would publish GitLab status '{{options.context}}'={{options.state}} for commit {{version.CommitSha}}; else glab api /projects/$PROJECT_ID/statuses/{{version.CommitSha}} -F state={{options.state}} -F context="{{options.context}}" -F description="{{options.description}}"; fi
